lines.text: On the first day of the seventh month, Ezra read the Law aloud from daybreak until noon in the square before the Water Gate.
Ezra stood on a high wooden platform, opened the book, and all the people stood up and said, "Amen, Amen!"
The Levites explained the Law to the people, and the people wept as they heard it.
Nehemiah told the people to go without food and mourn, since the joy of the LORD was their strength.

lines.text: The people built booths from branches, and they had not celebrated like this since the days of King David.
